title: Military Expects UK to Spend 3% of GDP on Defense By 2030
title_cn: 军方预计英国到 2030 年将 GDP 的 3% 用于国防
summary: The British military still expects Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey to commit to spending 3% of domestic output on defense by 2030, despite accusations that he was backsliding on his ambition to hit that target.

title: Bessent Says Hormuz Will Be ‘Worthless’ as Oil Bypasses It
title_cn: 贝森特称霍尔木兹将“毫无价值”，因为石油绕过它
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent dismissed the importance of the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, saying the crucial waterway for Persian Gulf energy that’s been controlled by Iran during the recent conflict will be bypassed by oil pipelines.

title: Ukraine Votes Down Tax Bills Required by IMF and EU for Aid
title_cn: 乌克兰投票否决国际货币基金组织和欧盟援助所需的税收法案
summary: Ukrainian lawmakers rejected legislation sought by the IMF and the European Union to remove some tax exemptions, potentially jeopardizing further payouts of aid from the biggest donors.
